info.name: Middleware Third-Party Service
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Middleware Third-Party Service.

All endpoints are public — no JWT required.

## Execute API Authentication
Execution endpoints use client secretKey via X-Secret-Key header.

## Setup Flow
1. Create Providers
2. Create Provider APIs
3. Configure Environment
4. Create Clients
5. Grant Access
6. Execute APIs
